expertiseSources.summary: Defines repository-first ADR naming and IDs, decision status, rejected alternatives, consequences, and supersession rather than rewriting accepted history.

exception.rationale: The workflow preserves accepted decision history and repository ADR naming conventions, prevents invented acceptance, and distinguishes safely executed setup/examples from traced or unavailable checks. It prohibits speculative destructive setup and dependency installation. These record-integrity and execution boundaries justify a requested safety exception rather than an unsupported average quality improvement; human approval and runtime uplift are not claimed.
